def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # frame interior split into four equal blocks; external markers determine pattern
    colors=[]
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):

    a,b=colors
    # For markers below the frame, align colors with bottom quadrants and reverse on top.
    if all(r>7 for r,c,v in colors):
        left=next(v for r,c,v in colors if c<5); right=next(v for r,c,v in colors if c>=5)
        quad=[[right,left],[left,right]]
    elif all(r<2 for r,c,v in colors):
        left=next(v for r,c,v in colors if c<5); right=next(v for r,c,v in colors if c>=5)

        top=next(v for r,c,v in colors if r<5); bottom=next(v for r,c,v in colors if r>=5)
